ValidationRule.description: If the Credit Pre-Screening Result is Accept than Approved Credit must be greater than or equal to new upgrade card minimum limit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), ISCHANGED(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, "Accept"), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase"), Is_Initiated_from_Upgrade_Case__c = true, cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c < sc_Spending_Limit_Amount__c, TEXT(cc_Control_Type__c) == "STP" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved limit must be greater than or equal to the minimum limit of the target credit card when the limit increase is initiated from an upgrade case
